case_number: 2025 INSC 66; CONTEMPT PETITION (C) NO. 449 OF 2021; CONTEMPT PETITION (C) NO. 1188 OF 2018; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 2703 OF 2017

parties.petitioner: Dr. Shyam Narayan Singh and Ors.

summary: Contempt petition regarding non-payment of pension and arrears of salary despite absorption orders; interim orders of 2019 and 2021 halted payments over concerns of non-actual working; fact-finding enquiry required; pension stoppage not directly addressed in prior orders; matter referred to Registrar/Vice Chancellor for adjudication on actual service, arrears, and pension; SCC 2005 citation applied; directions for claims, discrete enquiry, reasoned orders, and recovery of excess; appeal liberty preserved for High Court.
legal_provisions_cited: State of Bihar & others vs Bihar Rajya M.S.E.S.K.K.M & others (2005) 9 SCC 129
final_judgment: Contempt petition disposed of with directions to adjudicate claims of salary arrears and pension through Registrar/Vice Chancellor; payment to be made within two months of order; recovery of excess permitted; liberty to approach High Court against adjudication.
